firms.name: Lucid Trading
firms.summary: Public Pro, Flex, Daily and Direct plans; invitation-only Maxx; current live and legacy variants. Manual reference, checked September 26, 2026.

programs.name: LucidPro — DLL on / off
programs.overview: Choose daily loss limit on or off at purchase. Both configurations use the same core Pro payout model.

rules.text: In size order 25K/50K/100K/150K: targets $1,250/$3,000/$6,000/$9,000; loss allowances $1,000/$2,000/$3,000/$4,500; maximum minis 2/4/6/10 (10 micros per mini). One-day pass possible; one-time fee, no funded activation fee.
DLL on/off applies to both evaluation and funded stages and cannot be changed on an active account. DLL is a session lockout, unless the maximum loss threshold is also reached.
EOD trailing drawdown locks at starting balance +$100. Trail balances in size order: $26,100/$52,100/$103,100/$154,600; locked floors $25,100/$50,100/$100,100/$150,100. Touching the floor breaches.
When DLL enabled, published 50K/100K/150K initial limits are $1,200/$1,800/$2,700. Funded DLL becomes 60% of highest EOD profit after passing the trail balance and never decreases. See 25K conflict.
Funded accounts have full contract size immediately; no contract scaling plan.

90% trader share; $500 minimum. Per-cycle profit goals in size order: $250/$500/$750/$1,000; largest day ≤40% of cycle profit, resetting after payout. Leave buffers $26,100/$52,100/$103,100/$154,600. First caps $1,000/$2,000/$2,500/$3,000; later $1,500/$2,500/$3,000/$3,500. Request any eligible day; published processing within 2 business days. Pre-November 28, 2025 3 p.m. Eastern purchases/resets retain first-$10K 100% split eligibility. No separate fixed winning-day count is listed on this payout page.

uncertainties: 25K DLL conflict: funded table lists optional $600, while the dedicated DLL article lists none. Confirm the purchased configuration.
The funded overview says no simulated payout caps, but the payout article sets per-request caps and current live structure ends at payout 5. Use the detailed payout/current live pages.

programs.name: LucidFlex — DLL on / off
programs.overview: EOD drawdown evaluation; funded profit-day qualification and no funded consistency requirement.

rules.text: 25K/50K/100K/150K targets: $1,250/$3,000/$6,000/$9,000; loss allowances $1,000/$2,000/$3,000/$4,500; max minis 2/4/6/10 (micros ×10). 50% consistency with a two-day pass path. One-time fee, no activation charge.
DLL on/off selected at purchase applies to both stages and cannot be changed. Enabled DLL pauses trading until next session.
EOD trail locks at start +$100; trigger balances $26,100/$52,100/$103,100/$154,600. A payout request also forces the locked floor. Balance reaching the floor breaches.

Funded minis by profit tier, 25K/50K/100K/150K: $0–999 = 1/2/3/4; $1K–1,999 = 2/3/4/5; $2K–2,999 = 2/4/5/6; $3K–4,499 = 2/4/6/8; $4,500+ = 2/4/6/10. Micros ×10. Adjusts after each session, including down after withdrawals; evaluations do not scale.

Five qualifying days per cycle: at least $100/$150/$200/$250 daily profit by size. Positive cycle net profit; no funded consistency or payout buffer. $500 minimum; maximum 50% of profit capped at $1,000/$2,000/$2,500/$3,000. 90% trader share. Day count resets after approved payout; up to five sim payouts before live. Request any eligible day; processing within 2 business days.

uncertainties: Customization confirms optional DLL but reviewed Flex articles do not provide its numeric limits. Confirm the purchased DLL-on account values.

programs.name: LucidDaily — four configurations
programs.overview: Configurations: intraday evaluation + DLL on; intraday + DLL off; EOD evaluation + DLL on; EOD + DLL off. All funded Daily accounts use intraday drawdown.

rules.text: Evaluation drawdown (EOD/intraday) and DLL (on/off) are locked at purchase. Evaluation drawdown choice never changes the funded intraday model.

Targets by 25K/50K/100K/150K: $1,250/$3,000/$6,000/$9,000; loss allowances $1,000/$2,000/$3,000/$4,500; max minis 2/4/6/10 (micros ×10). 50% consistency, two-day path, one-time charge and no funded activation fee.
Drawdown locks at start +$100 after trigger balances $26,100/$52,100/$103,100/$154,600. Funded threshold tracks unrealized equity intraday; touching floor breaches.
DLL-on limits are fixed $600/$1,200/$1,800/$2,700 in both stages; DLL-off has none. Daily cap does not trail, but intraday loss floor can become stricter and cause hard breach.
Funded Daily accounts must be flat from 1 minute before through 1 minute after high-impact USD news. Holding or entering within that window is a hard breach. Funded consistency is absent.

90% trader share; $500 minimum. Retain buffers $26,100/$52,100/$103,100/$154,600 and earn positive net profit since last request. Withdraw profit above buffer, without a fixed request cap. Daily sim profit of $6K/$8K/$10K/$12K triggers live transition review. Request any eligible day; published processing within 2 business days.

Live review also depends on performance/history. Buffer funds starting live risk; above-buffer sim payout capped at $15,000 per trader after broker KYC. One live account per funded account with a payout; $0 start, EOD risk, no DLL/consistency. Daily has no live bonus. All sim accounts close at transition; risk team controls timing.

programs.name: LucidDirect
programs.overview: Straight to simulated funding with no evaluation.

rules.text: 25K/50K/100K/150K loss allowances $1,000/$2,000/$3,500/$5,000; initial DLL none/$1,200/$2,100/$3,000. Max minis 2/4/6/10, micros ×10; no contract scaling.
EOD drawdown locks at start +$100. Trail balances $26,100/$52,100/$103,600/$155,100. Reaching maximum loss floor breaches.
DLL is a soft session lockout. Once above initial trail, applicable scaling DLL is 60% of highest EOD profit, never decreasing. 25K has no DLL.

90% trader share; $500 minimum; 20% consistency resets each payout. First cycle profit goals $1,500/$3,000/$6,000/$9,000; later $1,250/$2,500/$3,500/$4,500. Caps payouts 1–3: $1,000/$2,000/$2,500/$3,000; 4–5: $1,000/$2,500/$3,000/$3,500. Request any eligible day; processing within 2 business days.

uncertainties: Funded overview says no simulated payout caps; detailed payout page supplies per-request caps. Payout 5 is the current general live transition ceiling.

programs.name: LucidMaxx — invitation only
programs.overview: Restricted eval-to-live program earned through performance, not public application.

rules.text: Five trading days and 40% consistency. Targets by 25K/50K/100K/150K: $1,250/$3,000/$6,000/$9,000; loss allowances $1,000/$2,000/$3,000/$4,500. Passing goes directly live under standard live drawdown.

Invite required. Up to 5 accounts; EOD drawdown, no DLL, 90% trader share and uncapped daily payouts without profit minimum. Existing Maxx evaluations may be traded/reset while live, but new purchases cannot be made while holding an active live account.
Two-week cooldown starts after the final live account closes; existing evaluations may continue. Reckless trading can extend cooldown or permanently restrict access.

programs.name: LucidLive — current standard structure
programs.overview: Current live destination for public plans; Daily-specific transition treatment is in its plan entry.

rules.text: Review by payout 5 or earlier at risk-team discretion; one live account per funded account with at least one payout. All sim accounts close. $0 live start; drawdown allowances $1K/$2K/$3K/$4.5K by size; EOD floor locks at $100 after sufficient profits or early withdrawal. No DLL/consistency; daily payouts. Standard cooldown two weeks. A household with a live trader cannot continue sim trading.

First eligible move live, excluding legacy-live/Maxx traders: one-time bonus $1K/$2K/$3K/$4.5K after closing profit reaches $1.1K/$2.1K/$3.1K/$4.6K; 90/10 split. A zero-payout funded account can receive evaluation-fee refund only if at least half its drawdown remains.

Live scaling follows EOD realized profits and product group. Starting CME/CBOT/NYMEX minis 1/2/3/4 by account size; COMEX equivalents smaller. At each $2K profit tier, size rises; full table linked. 150K ceilings differ: CME 10, CBOT 8, NYMEX 6, COMEX 5 minis. Never apply sim scaling to live.

programs.name: LucidBlack — legacy
programs.overview: Legacy plan retained for existing accounts.

rules.text: Targets $1,250/$3,000/$6,000; max loss $1K/$2K/$3K; evaluation consistency 60%; max minis 2/4/6 (micros ×10).
Evaluation and funded use EOD trailing drawdown, locking at start +$100.  Confirm original agreement for legacy applicability.
Funded mini scaling at profit $0/$1K/$2K/$3K: 25K 1/2/2/2; 50K 2/3/4/4; 100K 3/4/5/6. Micros ×10; updates each session.

90% share, $500 minimum, no payout buffer; consistency 40% per cycle. Profit goals $1.5K/$3K/$4.5K; standard caps $750/$1.5K/$2K. Payouts 2–4 can double those caps by hitting bonus goals $2.5K/$5K/$7K. Request any eligible day, processing within 2 business days.

Fourth payout or earlier discretionary move. Transfer caps $6K/$12K/$16K; day-one max $1.8K/$3.6K/$4.8K, remainder escrow. Escrow eligibility: 10 profitable live days plus $10K profit; $5K released per further $10K, reviewed weekly. Additional bonus pool 50% of escrow, after escrow released. Released escrow/bonus withdrawals wait 60 days.

programs.name: LucidFlex Live — legacy
programs.overview: For accounts purchased/reset February 27, 2026 or earlier; confirm original cohort.

rules.text: Move after sixth payout or earlier risk decision. Transfer caps in listed size order: $4K/$8K/$12K/$16K; day-one funding $1.2K/$2.4K/$3.6K/$4.8K. Excess forfeited; remainder escrow. Escrow review starts after 10 profitable days and $10K live profit; releases $5K per additional $10K, weekly review. Wait 60 days to withdraw released escrow. Earlier January onboarding may elect old $5K-per-account cap; confirm original notice.

programs.name: LucidPro Live — legacy
programs.overview: For accounts purchased/reset February 27, 2026 or earlier; confirm original cohort.

rules.text: Move after sixth payout or earlier risk decision. Transfer caps in listed size order: $15K/$20K/$25K/$30K; day-one funding $2K/$3K/$4K/$5K. Excess forfeited; remainder escrow. Escrow review starts after 10 profitable days and $10K live profit; releases $5K per additional $10K, weekly review. Wait 60 days to withdraw released escrow. For eligible January 19-or-earlier purchases/resets, article also offers older $150K aggregate funding structure.

programs.name: LucidDirect Live — legacy
programs.overview: For accounts purchased/reset February 27, 2026 or earlier; confirm original cohort.

rules.text: Move after sixth payout or earlier risk decision. Transfer caps in listed size order: $4K/$8K/$16K; day-one funding $1.2K/$2.4K/$4.8K. Excess forfeited; remainder escrow. Escrow review starts after 10 profitable days and $10K live profit; releases $5K per additional $10K, weekly review. Wait 60 days to withdraw released escrow. January onboarding may qualify for older caps $2.5K/$5K/$15K. 100K is absent from the legacy table.
Household/family maximum: 10 evaluations; 10 evaluations plus funded combined; 5 funded accounts across plan types; 5 live accounts.

Pro, Flex and Direct: close by 4:45 p.m. Eastern; reopen 6 p.m. Sunday–Thursday. Automatic closure at cutoff is not itself a failed account. Holiday early closes override. New live accounts cannot swing; Tradovate cutoff 4:45 p.m., Rithmic 4:15 p.m. Eastern.

News permitted on Pro, Flex and Direct. Automated strategies and trade copiers permitted subject to all rules; trader bears software failures. Genuine scalping, DCA and day-count flipping permitted. Daily has separate news restrictions.
No cross-account hedging, including other firms/users and correlated products. Same-account opposite positions in different products or mini/micro variants are distinguished in the policy.
Microscalping review triggers when more than 50% of profits come from trades held 5 seconds or less. Confirmed abuse can cause warnings, profit forfeiture and restriction.
High-frequency trading is prohibited; repeat offenses can remove profits, close accounts and permanently restrict access.
Do not exploit platform errors, delays or simulated-price discrepancies.

Every account must record at least $1 net profit or loss from trading within 30 calendar days; otherwise treated as abandoned. Breached evaluations must be reset within 30 days before automatic removal.

firms.name: Funded Futures Family
firms.summary: Prime, Premier+, Velocity, S2F Standard, S2F Accelerate, Base and invitation-only Prestige; Professional/PCA/Live progression. Several official pages conflict; account-specific terms need confirmation.

programs.name: Prime — Standard / Max
programs.overview: One-day evaluation path; Standard and Max position allowances are distinct.

rules.text: Targets $1,250/$3K/$6K/$9K by size; loss limits $1K/$2K/$3K/$4.5K. No evaluation consistency or DLL. Max minis Standard 2/4/6/10; Max 3/5/10/15 (micros ×10). Activate funded within seven days after passing.
Funded EOD trail locks at starting balance after $1K/$2K/$3K/$4.5K profit; withdrawals do not lower the floor. No DLL.

Funded scaling updates after session; evaluation does not scale. Published starts 1/3/4/5 minis, rising with profit. Max-variant ceilings 3/5/10/15. Source table marks Max-specific tiers; purchased Standard ceiling still applies.

90% share; three qualifying days at $200+ each; cycle profit goals $300/$500/$750/$1K; 40% consistency resets after payout. Retain buffers $26,100/$52,100/$103,100/$154,600. First payout caps $1K/$2K/$3K/$3.5K; later $1.5K/$2.5K/$3.5K/$4K.

uncertainties: Scaling article mixes Standard/Max allowances; confirm purchased variant and broker-approved ceiling. Do not give Standard accounts the Max size.

programs.name: Premier+ — EOD / Intraday; Standard / Fast Pass
programs.overview: Current cohort purchased September 9, 2026 onward. Choose EOD or intraday risk; Standard or Fast Pass evaluation duration.

rules.text: Targets $1.5K/$3K/$6K/$9K by size. EOD drawdowns $750/$1.5K/$2.5K/$4K; intraday $1K/$2K/$3K/$4.5K. No consistency or DLL; Standard two days, Fast Pass one. Current caps 2/4/6/10 minis (see 150K typo). Activate within seven days.

EOD floor locks at initial balance; intraday follows unrealized equity, with breach at/below floor. Payout does not reset the threshold. Intraday evaluation text says trail continues as balance grows.
Current funded contract ceilings: 2/4/6/10 minis by size, micros ×10; scaling applies. No DLL or activation fee. Five qualifying trading days between payouts.

Daily qualifying profit at least $200. 90% share; 40% consistency resets per payout for September 9+ cohort. Maximum 50% of profit, capped $1K/$2K/$2.5K/$3K. After first payout require at least $1 fresh net profit; first payout request raises drawdown floor to account base.

uncertainties: 150K EOD evaluation table transposes minis/micros; compare purchased contract limits.
Funded summary lists only larger drawdowns; dedicated drawdown article separately lists EOD $750/$1,500/$2,500/$4,000 and intraday $1K/$2K/$3K/$4.5K.
August scaling table exceeds September funded ceilings; confirm your purchased cohort before sizing.

programs.name: Premier+ — before September 9, 2026
programs.overview: Existing accounts retain their original funded consistency terms.

rules.text: Earlier evaluation max minis 3/5/10/15 (micros ×10); targets $1.5K/$3K/$6K/$9K. EOD/intraday variants continue. Original funded consistency terms retained for this cohort.
Published August scaling at profit tiers $0/$1K/$1.5K/$2K/$3K/$4.5K: minis 25K 1/2/2/3/3/3; 50K 3/3/4/5/5/5; 100K 4/4/6/7/10/10; 150K 5/5/7/10/12/15. Micros ×10; session-end adjustments.

uncertainties: Source does not fully restate every original funded term; use original agreement rather than assuming current 40%.

programs.name: Premier+ — giveaway / promotional accounts
programs.overview: Giveaway accounts have a specific payout exception.

rules.text: Seven trading days and 40% maximum single-day consistency before payout; these override the ordinary Premier+ day requirement for giveaway accounts.

uncertainties: Remaining terms follow the exact promotion and cohort; do not infer from retail Standard/Fast Pass.

programs.name: Velocity — Standard / Daily payout add-on
programs.overview: Intraday trailing plan; daily add-on changes payout qualification and caps.

rules.text: Targets $2.5K/$4K/$7K/$10K by size; drawdowns $1,250/$2,250/$3,250/$4,750; max minis 3/5/10/15 (micros ×10). Standard minimum three days and 40% consistency. Activate funded within seven days.

Intraday floor tracks highest unrealized account value minus loss allowance. It never moves down and does not reset after payout; withdrawals reduce cushion. Current article does not specify a stopping/lock balance.
Funded scaling applies. Minis at profit tiers $0/$1K/$1.5K/$2K/$3K/$4.5K: 25K 1/2/2/3/3/3; 50K 3/3/4/5/5/5; 100K 4/4/6/7/10/10; 150K 5/5/7/10/12/15. Micros ×10; EOD updates.

90% share. Standard: three qualifying $200+ days, 40% consistency (reset conflict noted); add-on: no day or consistency requirement, one request/day. Both require new cycle profit $1.5K/$3K/$6K/$9K. Standard caps $750/$1,250/$2,250/$3,250; add-on $600/$1K/$1.5K/$2.5K.
Dedicated consistency article says 40% calculation restarts after every approved payout, conflicting with the lifetime wording on the payout page.
Funded Velocity accounts have no daily loss limit.

uncertainties: Standard payout/evaluation pages say lifetime 40% consistency; dedicated Consistency page says it resets after each payout. Confirm in writing.
General marketing portrays most FFF plans as EOD, but current Velocity-specific pages explicitly use intraday trailing.
Daily add-on evaluation treatment is not completely clear: evaluation page lists waived days/consistency under an add-on heading referring to payouts. Confirm evaluation agreement.

programs.name: S2F Standard
programs.overview: Straight to funding with EOD risk and seven qualifying days.

rules.text: Loss allowances $1K/$2K/$3K/$4.5K by size. EOD trailing locks at original balance; trigger balances $26K/$52K/$103K/$154.5K. Withdrawals never reduce the loss floor.
No DLL. Funded summary lists max minis 1/5/10/15 (micros ×10), with scaling; see 25K discrepancy.
Scaling starts 1/3/4/5 minis by size; at $1K profit 2/3/4/5; $1.5K 2/4/6/7; $2K 3/5/7/10; $3K 3/5/10/12; $4.5K 3/5/10/15. Micros ×10; session-end updates.
Seven $200+ profit days; 90% share. Profit goals first payout $1.5K/$3K/$6K/$9K; later $1K/$2K/$3K/$4.5K. Caps requests 1–3: $1K/$2K/$2.5K/$3K; request 4: $1K/$2.5K/$3K/$3.5K.
25% best-day/total-profit consistency resets after each approved payout.

programs.name: S2F Accelerate
programs.overview: Instant simulated funding, distinct from S2F Standard.

rules.text: No evaluation; $50K only; full 5 minis/50 micros from day one, no contract scaling; $2K drawdown.
Intraday drawdown trails highest unrealized equity by $2,000 and never locks. No daily loss limit; withdrawal does not lower the peak-based floor.
Five winning days of $200+; lifetime 25% consistency. Leave $52,100 buffer after withdrawal. $500 minimum; first two caps $1,250, third onward $1,500; 90% share. Cannot withdraw the buffer.

programs.name: Base
programs.overview: A $2K-base product, not a $25K or $50K buying-power label.

rules.text: $3K target, $2K EOD loss allowance, 40% consistency, no DLL; maximum 5 minis/50 micros with dynamic limits.
Funded $2K intraday trailing risk stops after $2K profit; no DLL or consistency. Up to 15 minis/150 micros after scaling. Funded payouts give the trader 90% and need no qualifying day count.
Position size follows closed balance after positions close, not unrealized peaks. Examples: balance $1K→1 mini/10 micros, $2K→2/20, $4K→4/40; maximum 15/150 in funded.
Request $500–$1K while retaining $4K balance, requiring $4.5K for minimum or $5K for maximum. Earn at least $1 new net profit between payouts.

uncertainties: Evaluation overview says max 5 minis while scaling page permits up to 15 without stage separation. Respect the evaluation-specific 5-mini ceiling.

programs.name: Prestige — invitation only
programs.overview: Restricted advanced tier; also the re-entry path after professional/live exit.

rules.text: Five trading days, 40% consistency. Targets by size $2K/$4K/$6K/$9K; drawdowns $1K/$2K/$3K/$4.5K; max minis 3/5/10/15 (micros ×10). Invitation only; passing progresses to Professional, with no sim-funded payouts.

uncertainties: Prestige overview calls professional drawdown EOD, but newer Professional structure specifies EOP. Confirm assigned risk model before trading.

programs.name: Professional Stage (Pro execution)
programs.overview: Individual risk allocation, distinct from simulated funded rules.

rules.text: Eligible for review after 3 sim payouts OR $10K approved payouts; early advancement possible, never automatic. Initially one account. Assigned drawdown/DLL/contracts; EOP trail updates after a position closes, locking at start +$100. No consistency; 80% trader share.

Before 20 qualifying $200+ days: up to 50% available profit above required buffer. At 20 days: up to 100% above larger permanent buffer. Published 50K examples: $50,100 then $50,200 retained. $250 minimum; 80% share; account must exceed active drawdown. Other tiers require assigned buffer confirmation.

Scaling is based on EOD realized profit and requires Live Desk review plus broker configuration. Current approved size/DLL stays binding until change implemented. Mini tiers must be requested. After professional exit, return only through Prestige evaluation.

programs.name: Performance Check Account (PCA)
programs.overview: Discretionary recovery review for an existing Professional account, not a public purchase plan.

rules.text: Risk team may pause Professional account. PCA needs +$10K realized net profit, profit factor ≥1.5, ten $200+ winning days and no risk violations. One PCA per account; unavailable after recovered drawdown. Passing only permits discretionary reinstatement; failing closes PCA and associated Professional account; re-entry through Prestige.

programs.name: Live Market Execution (Rithmic)
programs.overview: Continuation of the Professional account, not a reset.

rules.text: Review after $5K approved Pro payouts or initial Pro payout with demonstrated progression. Broker documents and independently purchased data required. No performance reset; no environment-based live profit cap. Starting drawdown $2.5K/$3.5K/$4.5K; DLL $1K/$1K/$1,250; initial size 1 mini/10 micros. Increases discretionary. Exit requires Prestige for re-entry.
Household cap: five sim-funded accounts and one live-funded account. Shared household allowance is not five per person.
Close by 4:45 p.m. Eastern; reopen 6 p.m. Overnight session trading allowed, but not across daily market break. Auto-close at cutoff does not itself breach.
News trading permitted including Tier 1, with no required flattening window. Normal risk rules and responsibility for slippage remain.
Bots and algorithmic trading prohibited. VPN/VPS use permitted; that permission does not authorize automated execution.
More than 50% of trades AND more than 50% of profits must come from positions held longer than 10 seconds. Unrealistic fills, bots and manipulation can forfeit profits or close accounts.
Each account needs at least one trade held 10 seconds or longer per Monday–Friday week. One full idle trading week can permanently close it; arrange breaks with support ahead of time.
No exploiting errors, delays, pricing discrepancies, risk controls or payout systems; hedging between accounts prohibited.

Different traders cannot share a computer, phone or tablet for trading or account access, including dashboard-only access. Separate browser profiles do not avoid the restriction. Shared Wi-Fi alone is not device sharing.

Evaluations have recurring subscriptions ending on progression to funded. No funded activation or recurring subscription fee. Evaluations permit unlimited paid resets; sim funded up to three, excluding S2F. S2F uses one-time purchase.

Rise onboarding/KYC required; current help page says approvals at EOD, bank estimates 1–3 business days and crypto same day–24 hours. Qualifying-day count starts the day after a payout request; request-day trading does not count. Provider fees may apply.
Official Accelerate marketing page states a $100,000 total payout cap per user; its scope versus professional/live terms is unresolved.

firms.name: Topstep
firms.summary: Combine → simulated Express Funded → Live. Standard and Consistency payout paths differ; Labs are limited drops.

rules.text: Minimum $125; trader receives 90%. Pre-Jan 12,2026 new-dashboard members retain first-$10 K lifetime 100% treatment. Eligible checkout-DLL promotion doubles XFA caps; adding DLL only at XFA activation does not qualify.
Weekday flat by 3:10 pm CT; reopen 5 pm. No cross-session/weekend holding. Earlier-closing products require earlier exits. Futures only; check holiday/product hours.
Automation/copying own accounts permitted in simulated stages subject to conduct rules; no malfunction exceptions.
No hedging across accounts, coordinated trading, trading for others or circumventing geographic restrictions.
No account-stacking, intentional live depletion, simulator exploitation, unfair technology, unrealistic fills, or deliberately trading maximum size into major scheduled news.

SIM CPI window ±5 minutes: affected equity/metal minis cannot open; micros capped by size. Product-specific temporary restrictions also apply; check the linked current table and platform before trading.
XFA scaling uses mini equivalents, usually 10:1; SIL 5:1 and crypto micros have exceptions. Official text omits the main tier chart; platform Risk Settings is authoritative for next-session limit.
Responsible Trading Program can impose mandatory DLL and Consistency XFA path based on trading behavior.

programs.overview: Two billing paths; the trading parameters are the same.

rules.text: Targets by size: $3,000 / $6,000 / $9,000. Best day ≤55% of total profit; otherwise required total rises to best day ÷0.55. Minimum practical pass: 2 days.
EOD trailing maximum-loss distances: $2,000 / $3,000 / $4,500. Floor rises with EOD highs, never falls, and locks at starting balance. Touching the floor intraday, including open losses, fails.
Maximum 5/10/15 minis, normally 50/100/150 micros. Evaluation profits do not transfer; all accounts must share one profile.
Optional fixed checkout DLL: $1,000/$2,000/$3,000; follows into XFA. Hitting it flattens positions and blocks the session, not a permanent breach.
Monthly evaluation subscription. Standard requires XFA activation payment; No Activation Fee includes activation. No XFA monthly subscription.

programs.name: Express Funded — Standard
programs.overview: Starts at $0; account size is buying power.

rules.text: Each cycle: 5 winning days ≥$150; after the first payout, net profit since last payout must be positive. Withdraw up to half the balance, capped $2,000/$3,000/$5,000. MLL becomes $0 after payout; day count restarts.
EOD drawdown distances $2,000/$3,000/$4,500, initially below $0. Follow XFA scaling; maximum contracts adjust next session, not mid-session.
Up to 5 active XFAs. More than 30 inactive days may close an XFA. Size and payout-path selection cannot later change.

programs.name: Express Funded — Consistency
programs.overview: A separate payout path selected when activating XFA.

rules.text: Each cycle: 3 traded days and best day ≤40% of net profit. Withdraw half the balance at most, capped $3,000/$4,000/$6,000. After payout, MLL=$0; day count and consistency reset.
Starts at $0; EOD MLL distances $2,000/$3,000/$4,500. XFA scaling and chosen DLL apply.

programs.name: Live Funded
